title: Signal Cluster
description: A market signal formed AFTER dedup + semantic clustering (v0.2 §7, steps 6-10). signal_type is a single classification: single_source | cross_source | repeated | emerging | contradictory. A contradictory signal MUST carry counter_evidence_ids (semantic rule enforced by schema).

topic.description: Core theme of the cluster (canonical, deduped).

evidence_ids.description: ALL ledger evidence IDs in this cluster. Existence in the  ledger is a Phase 2 validator concern, not schema.

representative_evidence_ids.description: Subset shown to the LLM as representative quotes. Subset  semantics = Phase 2 validator.

source_diversity.description: Number of distinct sources/tiers behind the cluster.  1 = single-source signal.

volume.description: Number of items in cluster after dedup (never raw repost count).

signal_type.description: Single classification of the cluster's evidence posture.

novelty.description: Novelty factor 0-1: new in current window vs baseline.  1.0 = absent from baseline (v0.2 §10.1).

score.description: GTM Signal Score, computed by code from scoring.yaml.

supporting_evidence_ids.description: Evidence that supports the signal's main claim.

contradiction_assessed.description: False means assessment unavailable or invalid; do not promote this signal into facts.

counter_evidence_ids.description: Evidence that contradicts the signal's main claim. MUST be  non-empty when signal_type=contradictory. Absent = no  counter-evidence found.
